verses.text: "Shout it out loud! Do not hold back! Raise your voice like a trumpet! Tell my people about their rebellion, and the people of Jacob about their sins.

Every day they come looking for me and seem eager to learn my ways, as if they were a nation that does what is right and has not turned away from the commands of its God. They ask me for fair decisions and seem eager for God to come near them.

They say, 'Why have we fasted, and you have not seen it? Why have we humbled ourselves, and you have not noticed?' Look, on the day you fast, you do whatever you want, and you treat all your workers cruelly.
Look, your fasting ends in arguing and fighting, and in hitting each other with wicked fists. The way you fast today will not make your voice heard in heaven.

Is this the kind of fast I have chosen, only a day for people to humble themselves? Is it only to bow your head like a reed and lie on sackcloth and ashes? Is that what you call a fast, a day pleasing to the LORD?
No, this is the kind of fast I have chosen: to break the chains of injustice, to untie the ropes of the yoke, to set free those who are treated cruelly, and to break every yoke.
It is to share your food with the hungry, and to bring the poor and homeless into your house. When you see someone with no clothes, give them clothes. Do not turn away from your own family.
Then your light will break out like the dawn, and your healing will come quickly. Your righteousness will go ahead of you, and the glory of the LORD will guard you from behind.
Then you will call, and the LORD will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, 'Here I am.' If you get rid of the yoke of cruelty, stop pointing your finger, and stop speaking evil,
and if you give yourself to help the hungry and meet the needs of those who are suffering, then your light will rise in the darkness, and your gloom will become like the noonday sun.
The LORD will always guide you. He will satisfy your needs in a dry land and make your body strong. You will be like a garden that is well watered, like a spring whose water never runs dry.
Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins. You will build again on the old foundations. You will be called the Repairer of Broken Walls, the Restorer of Streets to Live In.

If you stop breaking the Sabbath, and stop doing as you please on my holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight and the LORD's holy day honorable, and if you honor it by not going your own way, not doing as you please, and not speaking idle words,
then you will find your joy in the LORD. I will make you ride on the heights of the land and feed you with the inheritance of your father Jacob." For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
